- Locate Invoice.Date from lines labelled "Data wystawienia / Erstellungsdatum" or similar.
- Locate GrandTotal.Amount from lines showing "Razem / Gesamtbetrag" or "Do zapłaty" with currency and numeric total.
- Locate Sender.VatId from seller block labelled "NIP / Steuernummer" or similar (also check page 2/3 for USt-IdNr).

- Preserve numeric formatting and decimals exactly as in source; do not infer missing values.
- If invoice criteria fail, return all fields empty.

Now I will extract the fields accordingly.
